scope: Khordha district — 4,389 enumerated valid inputs in qa/khordha_inputs.json

expected_status_distribution.ok: ~60% — Bhulekh ROR returns a typed record for ~2,600 of 4,389 inputs
expected_status_distribution.no_data: ~25% — plot exists but ROR is blank or the village is not yet digitized
expected_status_distribution.source_down: ~10% — Bhulekh portal timeout/5xx, captcha-blocked, or network error
expected_status_distribution.invalid_input: ~5% — village not in dictionary, search mode not supported, malformed identifier

bhulekh.contract_envelope_assertion: Every result, regardless of status, must pass BhulekhContract.safeParse()
ok_structural_invariants: every tenant has non-empty tenantName and area > 0

expected_status_distribution.ok: ~80% — WFS returns a polygon for ~3,500 of 4,389 inputs (only those with GPS coordinates)
expected_status_distribution.partial: ~5% — polygon found but truncated by MAX_FEATURES=500 or no containing polygon for the point
expected_status_distribution.source_down: ~5% — GeoServer 5xx, network timeout, or WFS response validation failure

bhunaksha.contract_envelope_assertion: Every result, regardless of status, must pass BhunakshaContract.safeParse()
ok_structural_invariants: data.plotNo, data.village, data.tahasil are strings (may be empty when BBOX-only)
If data.polygon is present, it has at least 4 vertices (closed ring)

cross_source_invariants.check_6_village_match: When both Bhulekh and Bhunaksha return ok, normalized(bhulekh.village) === normalized(bhunaksha.village)
cross_source_invariants.check_8_share_sum: When Bhulekh returns ok, sum of parse(share) fractions across all tenants equals 1.0 (within 0.001 tolerance)

regression_threshold.contract_envelope_pass_rate: 100% — every input must produce a Zod-valid contract envelope, no exceptions
regression_threshold.cross_source_invariant_failure_rate: 0% — when both fetchers return ok, no village or share-sum mismatch
regression_threshold.ci_offline_skip: When CLEARDEED_OFFLINE=1, only the first 5 inputs are exercised. Locally or in nightly, set RUN_FULL_CORPUS=1 to exercise all 4,389 inputs.
